text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season has arrived once again.
While preparing training for Sweep Tosho...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll help too! If there's anything you need, please just let me know!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tires, barbells, or even giant tunas!
I shall procure whatever it takes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess had come to the summer training camp for her own sake, too. When I told her to focus on her own training—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Not at all, please allow me to help!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because Sweep-san promised
that she would cast magic on Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is why I ask you to let me support you
in making that magic come true.
...Please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like a certain someone, she didn't look like she'd budge an inch.
...Since the opportunity presented itself, I decided to ask her to be Sweep Tosho's training partner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Or so it seemed, however.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek...!
Sweep, you're so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During the tandem run, a huge gap quickly opened between Sweep Tosho and Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Originally, the point of tandem training was to run side by side
and stimulate each other's competitive instincts, just like in a race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Kawakami Princess stayed
five lengths behind Sweep Tosho the entire time.
...Frankly, running side-by-side like this was pointless.
choice_data_list: Maybe the gap in skill was just too wide...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar, we're running one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes! Hurry up and get ready!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The second matching-pace run was the same. Once it started,
Kawakami Princess couldn't even get close to Sweep Tosho."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Familiar,
are you talking in your sleep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not that she couldn't contest the lead.
She's running away from the fight itself.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're scared, aren't you, Kawakami?
Scared of running side-by-side.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, there's no way you'd run such a boring race, holding yourself back like that.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-No!
It's certainly not trauma or anything like that...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is my reminder, and my vow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't suppress my competitive spirit because I desperately didn't want to lose,
so I pushed aggressively and bumped into my senior."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I swore!
I would never again lose control of myself
or run in a way that causes trouble for others..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't mock me!!
Did you really think you could compete with that!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Racing isn't just about safe, harmless fun! We're competing with our own bodies, so there's always the danger of collisions!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
“Everyone knew what they were getting into, though!
Even they told you that you didn't have to apologize, didn't they?!”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
B-But back then...
it was my fault for trying to challenge you...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I said!
What's so wrong with that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You didn't bump into them on purpose, so how long are you going to drag this out?!
That's not reflection, you're just moping around!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your words are nothing but excuses!
You're just looking away from your own weakness
and saying whatever is convenient!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...! That is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: If you hold back from pushing forward and just let someone else take the lead, is your dream gonna come true like that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's not right, is it?!
How can someone who doesn't even care about their own feelings save anyone else?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami. Make sure you come watch
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) without fail. That's an order!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to remind you
of what it feels like to want to win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Ms. Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Besides, thinking you can be of use to me in your current state is a hundred years too early!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez, every single one of them needs magic! There are way too many!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Once you guys get better,
I'm gonna work you to the bone for a thousand years!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Huffed up with determination, Sweep Tosho burns
with fighting spirit for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
And so, the summer training camp began.
